text: 1、市场全天宽幅震荡，三大指数涨跌互现。油气股集体大涨，中国海油、中曼石油、博迈科等涨停。煤炭板块拉升，淮北矿业、大有能源、兖矿能源等涨停。电力股反复走强，华银电力、华电辽能、立新能源等涨停。白酒股表现活跃，古井贡酒涨停，贵州茅台涨近6%。下跌方面，芯片股高开低走，德明利连续4日跌停；PCB概念股下挫，金安国纪等跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超3700股飘绿，今日成交2.72万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.85%，深成指跌0.71%，创业板指涨0.42%。 2、板块概念方面，油气、电力、煤炭、白酒等板块涨幅居前，电子特气、光刻机、PCB、存储芯片等板块跌幅居前。
text_en: 1. Market oscillated broadly throughout the day, with three major indexes mixed. Oil stocks surged, CNOOC, Zhongman Petroleum, and BOMAI Offshore hit daily limits. Coal sector rose, Huaibei Mining, Dayou Energy, and Yankuang Energy hit limits. Power stocks strengthened repeatedly, Huayin Electric Power, Huadian Liaoning Energy, and Lixin Energy hit limits. Baijiu stocks active, Gujing Gongjiu hit limit, Kweichow Moutai rose nearly 6%. On downside, chip stocks opened high and fell, DML hit limit down for 4 consecutive days; PCB concept stocks fell, Jinan Guojie et al. hit limits. More stocks fell than rose, over 3,700 stocks declined on Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen exchanges, today's turnover 2.72 trillion. At close, Shanghai Composite rose 0.85%, Shenzhen Component fell 0.71%, ChiNext rose 0.42%. 2. Leading sectors: oil, power, coal, baijiu; lagging sectors: electronic specialty gases, lithography machines, PCB, memory chips.
